[Thinking]
**Determining solar eclipse date**

I need to find the date of the last solar eclipse before the year 2000. This means I'm focusing on eclipses in 1999. I see there were two solar eclipses that year: an annular eclipse on February 16 and a total eclipse on August 11. It looks like those are the only two, so the last solar eclipse before January 1, 2000, is definitely the one on August 11, 1999.
[/Thinking]

The last **solar eclipse before the year 2000** was on **August 11, 1999**.

It was a **total solar eclipse**, visible across parts of Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
